audit.why: Favoured 4/10, 53.47% WR, both layers and the packet chart agree Vex on all seven rows. No chart work needed.
Spikes: 3-5 W-interrupt of shadow swaps, 6 counter to Death Mark, first item burst inside his ult window, late anti-assassin. All present.

audit.whatIsWrong: Missing interaction: Zed is untargetable during the Death Mark dash, so a pre-emptive W pulse whiffs entirely — the page told you to pulse his 'dash arrival' without saying the pulse must come after he lands. Also no cooldown numbers anywhere.
audit.why: Kit: Zed R flagged untargetable; R 120/110/100, W 20/19/18/17/16.
audit.corrected: Folded the after-he-lands timing into cooldowns and the dos bullet; added Living Shadow 20s as the engage-window number.
Added Death Mark 120s, Living Shadow 20s, own W 16s, R 140s.

edits.before: - Zed Death Mark: matchup-defining — The all-in — spend your defensive answer AFTER the mark lands, not before. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget W Personal Space for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Zed Death Mark: matchup-defining, 120s — untargetable on the dash, so pulse W AFTER he lands, never before. - Living Shadow is 20s at rank 1: with it down he cannot engage. - Your W (16s) is the emergency; the R (140s) the opportunity.

edits.before: E-mark the contact, Q through the marked line for the fear, auto, walk — every trade he answers with a dash just schedules the next fear.
edits.after: He is untargetable during the R dash itself — hold the pulse until he appears behind you, then the fear catches him in melee range.

edits.before: Spending the W pulse on poke spacing and then eating the real engage unfeared — the pulse is the matchup against everything that moves fast.
edits.after: With Doom spent and W down, chasing into his 20s Living Shadow timer is the one fight Zed wins — take the trade you got and reset.

notes: Chart already consistent across both layers and the packet — no chart edits. The dash-punish trade template is the genuine mechanic vs Zed, so tradeGood/tradeBad stay; only the two lint-flagged duplicate bullets were rewritten, folding in the Death-Mark-untargetability missing interaction. Content spikes[2] recommends Blackfire Torch/Liandry's while report[8] says Luden's — same build disagreement as the yone page; noted, not adjudicated. Content claim that E fear 'stops him detonating the mark' is loose (the mark pops on its own timer; fear stops his follow-up damage) but within reasonable coaching shorthand — left alone.
